segment.source:
::The first reaction you get from this four-legged Faceless is a blank, expressionless stare. Seemingly more metal than flesh, all visible skin on this cybernetic creature has either tubes or wires connecting it to some mechanical part, especially around the abdomen, appearing as though his intestines have spilled out to connect with the massive quadrupedal base. Strange cylinders protrude from the pale skin of the right arm, while a heavy chain gun is attached to the other, mechanical one.
The Faceless activates his synthesized voice and speaks to you.::
<end>
